ava: Quick flag: p99 jumped ~160ms on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate in eu-central after we flipped the "graceful-overflow" routing policy to enable spillover. p50/p95 steady. Small requests (<25 tokens) hit the tail. :thinking:
noor: i see it. The dashboard blended line moved but when i split by variant the rdw-gpt-q4_microbatch trace shows the tail.
ben: timeline: graceful-overflow canary ramped 0->30% at 07:05. deploy-bot: rollout graceful-overflow-canary id=canary-2026-03-24T07:05 -> 30% complete.
ava: ran this quick query to compare percentiles vs raw counts: ```SELECT route, model_variant, routing_policy, percentile(lat_ms,99), count(*) FROM latency WHERE env='eu-central' AND route='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN 6180000000 AND 6180000600 GROUP BY model_variant,routing_policy```
noor: raw counts show q4_microbatch=260 samples, q3_stable=6100 samples in window. rollup metadata flagged "merged_tdigests":true but merged_count missing.
telemetry-bot: noted: rollup-emitter v2.1 emits merged_tdigests=true, merged_count=null for this window.
ben: if tdigest merges are unweighted or merged_count isn't used, a small sketch with an extreme tail will pull the blended p99. that's our suspect A.
noor: suspect B: microbatch kernel has a batch_timeout of 8ms to wait for fills; if fallback pool queue depth increases that wait adds to small-request latency. check worker queue depth and batch fill stats.
infra-bot: fallback-eu pool metrics: worker_count=5, avg_queue_depth=6.8 between 07:06-07:12; batch_fill_wait_ms p50=3ms p95=12ms p99=48ms.
ava: that batch_fill p99=48ms could explain some tail but not the full +160ms. combined with tdigest merge bias it explains blended spike.
ben: action items: 1) telemetry -> emit merged_count and switch to weighted merge; 2) infra -> bump fallback-eu workers + monitor queue depth; 3) console-ux -> add provenance pill (merged vs raw) and sample-count badge; 4) oncall -> reduce canary to 5% if queues don't drop.
noor: i'll open telemetry PR now with unit tests for unequal-count merges. will include a flag in rollup metadata when weighted vs unweighted merge used.
telemetry-bot: PR #922 opened by noor: "tdigest: emit merged_count + weighted merge + metadata flag".
console-ux: creating small UX change: show "provenance: merged_tdigest (unweighted)" or "merged_tdigest (weighted)" and display per-series sample counts on hover. target: today afternoon.
infra-bot: scaling: fallback-eu +2 workers requested by infra at 07:20; new worker_count=7 as of 07:21. avg_queue_depth fell to 2.1 within 3 minutes.
sre-oncall: lowering canary to 5% now while telemetry change lands. deploy-bot: canary graceful-overflow scaled to 5% at 07:25.
ava: good. i'll annotate the dashboard with the canary timeline + a note: "blended percentiles may be affected by merged sketches; inspect raw samples when p99 changes".
ben: once telemetry PR merges we'll reprocess recent rollups to emit merged_count so dashboard can surface correct provenance retroactively.
noor: noted. postmortem plan: document multi-factor cause: (1) unweighted tdigest merge artifact; (2) batch-fill waiting on fallback pool under canary; (3) rollout weight increased too quickly. include mitigation steps (provenance UI, weighted merge, autoscale tuning, rollout cadence guidance).
ava: filing INC-1401 (latency: blended p99 spike during graceful-overflow canary). tagging @sre-oncall and @eng-oncall. :memo:
